inputs.packageInputs: task24 immutable installed package closure; frozen install reused, no rebuild or registry substitute

invocation.environment: private HOME, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, workspace, TMPDIR and XDG roots; minimal PATH; loopback server bound only to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port
invocation.runtimeImports: installed package exports only; no source-workspace import, session.agent.streamFn replacement, CLI/RPC substitute, or internal monkey-patch

apiOwners.use: Two sessions created against synthetic local OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible models; both used the same caller-owned ModelRegistry/AuthStorage lifecycle.
Owned SQLite store; API-key records were persisted, rotated, removed, cold-reopened after explicit credentials.reload(), and closed.

Supported transport-only provider registrations plus live stored-key resolution; no provider config key was installed, so AuthStorage remained the request credential owner. Removal resolved no key before transport.
Built synthetic public Model values for the registered transports without mutating registry internals.

Full factory discovered the owned .agents/skills fixture, included its description in the provider system prompt, advertised read, and delivered public-builder output through a user-attributed skill message.
Recorded factory tool lifecycle events and prompt admission/idle/disposal without retaining raw arguments, provider payloads, or tool results.
Actual provider tool calls went through the full factory and its tool/approval wrappers; no custom echo tools were used.

syntheticHostShapeTranslation.limit: Synthetic field mapping only; this is not the application's Host credential API or a real credential handoff.

anthropicCompatible.limit: The fixture was a non-official loopback endpoint; this does not establish official upstream header policy or external provider auth.

authAndProtocols.secretHandling: Synthetic keys were compared only in process; no key, secret file, raw request/response, prompt text, real endpoint, or real model was written to output.

skills.limit: No CLI slash-command behavior, user Composer handling, or Host installation path was tested.

permissions.limit: No interactive approval was answered; Host Gatekeeper interception, service CAS, stale request rejection, restart expiry, and question UI were not tested.

probeSetupCorrections.detail: An early custom-model registerProvider attempt failed source-backed runtime-registration validation because custom model definitions require a configured apiKey or OAuth registration. The final probe registered only baseUrl/api and built the synthetic models through public buildModel, leaving stored AuthStorage keys authoritative.

An early Anthropic fixture omitted SSE event-type frames and used the OpenAI [DONE] terminator; it produced seven authenticated loopback requests without a completed turn. The final protocol-conforming event stream completed with one authenticated request. This was a disposable fixture defect, not a provider-capability pass/fail.

unexercised.approvedRealProviderEnvironment: not inspected or used; availability remains unknown

limits: The controlled local protocol proves the installed SDK can use a stored api_key, react to rotation/removal, and cold-reopen SQLite for this fixture; it does not prove a real upstream credential import or provider availability.
Anthropic's observed Bearer header belongs to the custom loopback endpoint and is not evidence for official Anthropic authentication, OAuth, refresh, or scope behavior.

This task is one installed public-factory slice only; task 26/27 evidence and the authoritative M0 gate review remain separate. Gate 03 remains blocked until every original M0 requirement has observed evidence or an explicit maintainer decision.
